name: Context.dev

team.summary: Built by Yahia, a solo founder with prior experience at Amazon and Sunrun, and co-founded StockAlarm.io and essense.io (both acquired), plus knifegeek.io and Brand.dev.

product.summary: Context.dev is an API that provides structured data, clean Markdown, rendered HTML, brand assets, and LLM-ready context from any website for software products and AI agents.

market.summary: Targeting developers and AI agent builders needing live web data, competing in a crowded web scraping and retrieval API space.

risks.risk: Extremely crowded and commoditized market with many direct competitors like Firecrawl, Browserbase, and well-funded players like Exa and Parallel.
Pushback from website owners and anti-scraping measures blocking requests or restricting access.

founder_depth.why: Founder Yahia has deep domain expertise with prior shipped products and multiple exits (StockAlarm.io, essense.io) and previous iterations in the space (Brand.dev, knifegeek.io).

shipping_evidence.why: Product is live with working APIs, SDKs in multiple languages, docs, a public site, tiered pricing, and active production usage.

demand_signal.why: Strong HN launch with 119 points and 86 comments, plus named customers like Mintlify, SiteGPT, and daily.dev.

defensibility.why: Features caching layers and brand extraction depth, but operates in a highly commoditized scraping and API wrapper market with numerous alternatives.

analysis.thesis_fit_reason: Context.dev is an AI infrastructure and developer tool providing APIs for web data and agent context, used by software engineers and AI builders.
analysis.case_summary: Strong technical founder with a proven shipping track record and live enterprise customers, offset by intense competition in a crowded scraping market.
would_change_my_mind: Demonstrating proprietary scraping infrastructure that consistently bypasses advanced anti-bot measures better than competitors
Achieving rapid net-new ARR growth despite a crowded field of well-funded incumbents
Building unique defensible data assets beyond standard web extraction and caching
data_gaps: Exact revenue or current paid customer counts
GitHub repository stats or public open-source code contributions
